### What is this?

_Describe the new user experience or the new components that comes with this ticket._

### Why is this important?

_Document the impact of this ticket, so that its level of priority is clear to every reader. What does this ticket enable? Two sentences are ideal. Five sentences is a maximum._

### How to implement it?

_You can list implementation options, and document which ones have been preferred and why. You can also refer to a previous similar implementation when possible._

_You need a specific Definition of Done for this ticket, expressed as a todo list. For example:_

### Definition of Done

- [ ] update operating procedure in file ...
- [ ] update architectural diagram in file ...
- [ ] update feature file ...
- [ ] add test fixture in file ...
- [ ] write a new test in file ...
- [ ] add code to file ...
- [ ] pass `make lint`
- [ ] deploy in staging environment
- [ ] deploy in production environment
